name: Popl
description:
Popl for Claude is your AI assistant (MCP) for event lead capture, helping marketing and revenue teams enrich, analyze, prospect, and report on event data through natural language.

Before an event, Popl for Claude helps teams identify target accounts, enrich attendee and exhibitor lists, match prospects against CRM data, and prioritize the right people to meet. After the event, teams can analyze captured leads, surface key insights, measure performance, and generate detailed ROI reports without manually sorting through spreadsheets or dashboards.

Popl for Claude connects your event data with Popl’s AI-native enrichment engine and broader in-person data layer, giving your team a faster, more conversational way to understand every event. Ask questions, uncover opportunities, and turn offline interactions into structured, actionable data that drives follow-up and revenue.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Popl to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Popl to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.popl.co/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Popl MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Popl provides these MCP tools: get_campaign_roi, get_leads, list_campaigns, list_members, person_enrichment_by_linkedin, person_enrichment_by_name_company, prospect_enrich_selected, and prospect_search_at_company.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Popl?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Popl in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Popl requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Popl is developed by Popl. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
